Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 19-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Quality Manager/Compliance Monitoring Manager : An engineering degree from aeronautical, mechanical, electrical, electronic, avionic or an aircraft maintenance technician, or Studies relevant to the maintenance and continuing airworthiness of aircraft/aircraft components SMS Qualified Knowledge of DGCA regulations and relevant regulation legislation governing or affecting operation/maintenance of the aircraft Good working knowledge of computer applications Satisfies the requirements as stipulated in DGCA CAR-CAMO Minimum 05 years of experience in aviation Industry in tasks related to aircraft maintenance and/or continuing airworthiness management and/or Quality Manager (CMM).

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Airports Authority of India (AAI) for hiring aviation professionals on a contract basis in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being offered in this AAI notification?
faq.answer: The Airports Authority of India is recruiting candidates for the position of Quality Manager / Compliance Monitoring Manager under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this role?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Quality Manager / Compliance Monitoring Manager position in the Airports Authority of India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form via email is 19-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Quality Manager / Compliance Monitoring Manager role will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 75,000 to Rs. 1,50,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an engineering degree in aeronautical, mechanical, electrical, electronic, avionic, or be an aircraft maintenance technician, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 65 years, which may be extendable up to 70 years as per the guidelines of the Airports Authority of India.

faq.question: Q8. Through which mode should applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through email at [email protected] and [email protected] in the prescribed format along with all required supporting documents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for AAI recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the shortlisting of received applications followed by a personal interview of eligible candidates shortlisted by the authority.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Quality Manager / Compliance Monitoring Manager position.
